title: The Midnight Big Top
blurb: A circus tent has appeared at midnight and its ringmaster is missing. Help the acts put on the show before dawn!

any: At the stroke of midnight, a striped tent appears.
A sign says: SHOW AT DAWN. RINGMASTER MISSING.
Music drifts from a tent that wasn't there before.
Inside, the acts are wringing their hands.

choices.label: Step inside
choices.text: {hero} lifts the flap. The whole circus looks up hopefully.

choices.label: Read the poster
choices.text: The poster lists every act. One face is scribbled out: {villain}!

hooks.title: The Empty Top Hat
text: A tall top hat sits alone on the tent steps.
The ringmaster is nowhere to be seen.

choices.label: Blow the whistle
choices.text: TWEEEET! Every act comes running to the ring.

choices.label: Peek in the hat
choices.text: {hero} peeks in. A sleepy rabbit yawns and hops out.

deed.text: found a rabbit in a top hat

beats.title: The Jugglers' Muddle
text: The jugglers have dropped every pin, ball and ring.
"Someone swapped all our things!" they wail.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so you know who to blame.

choices.label: Learn to juggle
choices.text: {hero} picks up three balls. How hard can it be?

game.intro: Keep the balls in the air!

win.text: {winner} juggles so well the jugglers cheer and join in.

lose.text: {loser} juggles one ball. Then zero balls. Bonk.

deed.text: juggled one ball onto their head

choices.label: Sort the pins
choices.text: {hero} lays every pin and ring out in rows.

game.intro: Match each act with its props!

win.text: {winner} gives every juggler the right props back.

lose.text: {loser} hands a juggler a rubber chicken. It goes in the act.

deed.text: added a rubber chicken to the act

beats.title: The Balancing Seal
text: A seal on a stool honks sadly.
Its striped ball is gone, and it has nothing to balance.

choices.label: Toss it a ball
choices.text: Everyone hunts for something round and bouncy.

game.intro: Land the ball on the seal's nose!

win.text: {winner} lands it right on the seal's nose. HONK!

deed.text: tossed a ball onto a seal's nose

lose.text: {loser} gets the ball bounced straight back by the seal.

deed.text: played catch with a seal and lost

choices.label: Fetch it a snack
choices.text: {hero} grabs a little net. The seal looks very interested.

game.intro: Catch a fish for the seal!

win.text: {winner} lands a fat fish. The happy seal balances it!

deed.text: caught a fish for the circus seal

lose.text: {loser} catches an old boot. The seal balances that instead.

deed.text: fished up a boot for a seal

beats.title: The Tumbling Troupe
text: The tumbling troupe can't finish their human tower.
They need just one more on the very top.

choices.label: Climb to the top
choices.text: {hero} steps onto the first pair of shoulders.

win.text: {winner} stands tall at the top and waves. Ta-da!

lose.text: {loser} wobbles and lands softly in a pile of tumblers.

choices.label: Hold the mat
choices.text: Everyone grabs a corner of the big crash mat.

win.text: Every flip lands safe. The troupe tries even bigger tricks!

deed.text: caught every tumbler on the mat

lose.text: One tumbler lands in the popcorn, but they love it.

beats.title: The Sleepy Strongman
text: The strongman has dozed off under his giant barbell.
He snores so loudly the tent poles shake.

choices.label: Wake him gently
choices.text: {hero} tiptoes over with a feather and a kazoo.

win.text: {winner} plays so gently he wakes up smiling.

deed.text: woke the strongman with a song

lose.text: {loser} toots too loud and gets a sleepy bear hug.

choices.label: Lift the barbell
choices.text: {hero} rubs both hands together and grabs the bar.

win.text: {winner} lifts it an inch. He wakes up, very impressed.

lose.text: {loser} finds the barbell is painted foam. Oops, wrong one.

beats.title: The Costume Trunk
text: The costume trunk is a jumble of sequins and feathers.
Nobody can find anything to wear!

choices.label: Design new outfits
choices.text: {hero} grabs scissors, glue and every feather in sight.

win.text: {winner} makes a cape so sparkly the whole tent gasps.

lose.text: {loser} glues a feather boa to their own elbow.

deed.text: wore a feather boa on one elbow

choices.label: Find the pairs
choices.text: {hero} starts matching shoes, gloves and hats.

win.text: {winner} finds every pair. The acts are dressed in a flash.

lose.text: {loser} ends up in two left clown shoes. Honk honk.

beats.title: Shadows on the Tent
text: Giant shadow puppets dance across the canvas.
{villain} has stolen the spotlight to make them!

choices.label: Chase the shadow
choices.text: Everyone runs after the darting shadow.

win.text: {winner} grabs the spotlight back. Light floods the ring!

lose.text: {loser} chases their OWN shadow round a tent pole.

choices.label: Spot the real one
choices.text: Lots of shadows, but only one is holding the spotlight.

game.intro: Which shadow is the real one?

win.text: {winner} points right at the real one. Caught!

lose.text: {loser} grabs a shadow bunny. It was made by a clown.

beats.title: The Ticket Booth
text: People are already queuing for the dawn show!
But the wind has scattered every ticket.

choices.label: Sell them fast
choices.text: {hero} jumps into the booth. "Roll up, roll up!"

win.text: {winner} sells every seat. The queue cheers!

lose.text: {loser} sells a ticket to a very polite goose.

deed.text: sold a ticket to a goose

choices.label: Gather the tickets
choices.text: Everyone chases tickets across the grass.

win.text: {winner} gathers the most. Every seat is filled!

lose.text: {loser} ends up with a ticket stuck to their forehead.

deed.text: wore a ticket on their forehead

beats.title: The High Wire
text: {prize} hangs from the very middle of the high wire.
{villain} put it there to stop the show!

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. Balancing is in your blood now.

choices.label: Walk the wire
choices.text: {hero} takes the long pole and steps out. Wobble…

win.text: {winner} tiptoes all the way and unhooks {prize}.

lose.text: {loser} bounces into the safety net. Again! Again!

choices.label: Hold the net
choices.text: Everyone stretches the net wide and tight.

win.text: The wire twangs, {prize} drops, and the net catches it!

deed.text: caught the prize in the net

lose.text: It bounces off the net and lands in a clown's pocket.

beats.title: The Big Rehearsal
text: One quick rehearsal before the doors open.
Everyone is nervous. Who will lead the parade?

extra.text: The jugglers toss pins in a perfect rainbow.

choices.label: Lead the parade
choices.text: Everyone lines up behind a big bass drum.

win.text: {winner} leads the best parade the ring has ever seen.

lose.text: {loser} marches the wrong way and leads a lone llama out.

deed.text: led a llama the wrong way

choices.label: Write the show
choices.text: {hero} grabs a chalkboard and starts planning.

game.intro: Put the acts in the best order!

win.text: {winner} writes a running order that makes everyone grin.

lose.text: {loser} writes "seal, seal, seal, seal". The seal approves.

beats.title: Curtain Trouble
text: {villain} has tied the big red curtain in knots!
The show can't start if no one can see it.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. A few knots won't stop you.

choices.label: Untie the knots
choices.text: {hero} studies the tangle like a puzzle.

win.text: {winner} pulls one rope and every knot falls away.

lose.text: {loser} ties themself into the curtain like a sausage roll.

deed.text: got wrapped up in the curtain

choices.label: Heave it open
choices.text: Everyone grabs a rope and leans back.

win.text: {winner} gives the last tug. SWOOSH! The curtain flies open.

lose.text: {loser} sits down hard in the sawdust. Applause anyway!

interludes.title: The Popcorn Cart
text: A popcorn cart is popping all by itself.
Warm, buttery popcorn spills onto the sawdust.

choices.label: Hand it to the acts
choices.text: {hero} fills a bag for every act. Happy crunching!

deed.text: fed popcorn to the whole circus

choices.label: Catch it in your mouth
choices.text: {hero} catches eleven in a row. A new circus act!

deed.text: caught popcorn eleven times in a row

interludes.title: {ally} Waves
text: {ally} shuffles over with warm milk and honey.
"You look like you need a little rest."

choices.label: Sit for a minute
choices.text: Warm mugs, tired feet. Everyone feels ready again.

deed.text: shared warm milk in the wings

choices.label: No time, showtime!
choices.text: {hero} gulps it down and cartwheels away.

deed.text: cartwheeled off with a milk moustache

climax.title: The Show Stealer
text: The crowd is seated. Then the lights go out!
{villain} juggles the spotlights high above the ring.

extra.text: One spotlight is already yours. It shines bright!

choices.label: Catch the lights
choices.text: Everyone takes their places around the ring. Ready!

win.text: Every light snaps back on! {villain} bows and joins the show.

lose.text: {villain} slips off into the dark with {prize}.

choices.label: Out-juggle them
choices.text: {hero} shouts: "Bet you can't juggle better than us!"

win.text: {winner} out-juggles {villain}, who hands back {prize}.

lose.text: {loser} juggles a pie, which ends up on their face.

deed.text: got a pie in the face

climax.title: Showtime Before Dawn
text: The sky is turning pink. Dawn is coming!
But {villain} has hidden {prize}, and the show can't start.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. The whole circus has your back.

extra.text: Out front, the full crowd starts to clap and stamp.

choices.label: Find {prize}
choices.text: {hero} looks behind every hoop and drum.

win.text: {winner} finds {prize} in a cannon! The show begins!

lose.text: {loser} looks inside a drum and gets stuck for a bit.

choices.label: Put on the show anyway
choices.text: Everyone takes a deep breath and steps into the light.

game.intro: Perform together and win the crowd!

win.text: The crowd roars! {villain} is so moved, they give back {prize}.

deed.text: put on the dawn show together

lose.text: The show goes on, but {villain} sneaks off with {prize}.

any: The sun comes up on the best show ever.
{villain} now juggles in the opening act.
Dawn. The crowd goes home humming.
The ringmaster turns up, amazed: "Who did all this?"
The tent fades with the morning mist.
But the acts will never forget you.
The circus promises to come back next midnight.

lines.text: The seal balances a ball with your name on it.
The strongman lifts the whole party up for a photo.
The sleepy rabbit hops into your pocket for good.
Everyone goes home smelling of popcorn.
